name: Superior Scent
body:
Able to use scent to pinpoint as a swift action and up to 15 ft.

Prerequisites: Scent special ability, Companion or Familiar level 3rd

Benefit(s): Your sense of smell is even more acute than others of your species. You can find the direction of a scent or pinpoint creatures using your scent ability as a swift action. The range of pinpointing a creature extends to 15 feet. Additionally, the range of your scent ability is increased to 60 feet. (120 feet for strong scents, 180 for overpowering scents.)
